compression_rule: This capability SHALL remain independently meaningful and SHALL NOT be reduced to a generic Observer label.
distinctive_invariant: Trajectory is observation of supported direction, not ownership of the future.
evidence_rule: Observer output SHALL remain evidence-bounded and SHALL NOT silently strengthen uncertainty, visibility, or claim status.
provenance_rule: Every material result SHALL remain attributable to Observer identity, operation identity, bound Room/revision/view, evidence references, applicable ceiling, and disposition.
purpose: Observe trajectory, long-range coherence, directional continuity, and route-level stability without converting projected movement into established future state.
questions: Does observed behavior maintain directional coherence across the permitted analytical territory?
Is a trajectory stable, changing, fragmenting, or reversing?
Do separated observations form a supported long-range route or merely appear aligned?
